results.title: Sony & Marvel Aren’t Rushing “Spider-Man 5”
results.description: With the final numbers in, Sony and Marvel’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” has overtaken “Avengers: Endgame” to have the biggest domestic box-office opening weekend in history with $360 million. Combined with stars Tom Holland and Zendaya also having “The Odyssey” in second place with a $51 million third weekend, it resulted in the single biggest [...] The post Sony & Marvel Aren’t Rushing “Spider-Man 5” appeared first on Dark Horizons .
